capabilities: style internal links based on target note tags, frontmatter properties or file path
create selectors that add colors, backgrounds and emoji before or after links
expose target note metadata as data-link HTML attributes and --data-link- CSS variables
apply link styling across live preview, reading mode, file browser and supported community plugins
edit target note frontmatter from the link context menu (deprecated)
extras: The link context menu feature for editing frontmatter is explicitly deprecated and migrated to the metadata-menu plugin; the rest of the plugin remains active. Styling without Style Settings is possible but requires writing your own CSS snippets. The README notes its demo videos are outdated.
problem: Obsidian renders all internal links the same, so you cannot visually tell from a link what kind of note it points to or what its properties are.

relations.evidence: Install and enable the Style Settings Plugin in Obsidian.
This functionality is deprecated and has been migrated to metadata-menu plugin

summary: Link styling plugin that adds CSS data attributes and variables to internal links based on the target note's frontmatter, tags or path.
